## Does this conflict with any core principle?

Please check [ARCHITECTURE.md](../ARCHITECTURE.md) Section 3 (Core Principles) before submitting.

- [ ] Knowledge lives in weights
- [ ] Never forget (frozen neurons never update)
- [ ] Grow when needed
- [ ] From scratch (no external ML frameworks)
- [ ] One `.manas` file
- [ ] Honest claims
